map.按儿童月龄显示年龄线及以下的 96 项自评清单，逐项勾选通过/未通过后统计各能区: Shows a 96-item self-check for the child's age line, counts delayed items per domain after you mark pass/fail, and gives a screening hint. This is not the full 125-item Denver II and does not replace professional screening or diagnosis.
map.清单结构为 4 个能区 × 12 个年龄组 × 2 项 = 96 项：个人-社会: The checklist is 4 domains x 12 age groups x 2 items = 96 items: personal-social, fine motor-adaptive, language and gross motor. The page only shows items on or below the age line (skills the child should already have) plus the two groups to the right of it.
map.延迟项只统计年龄线及以下的未通过项: Only failed items on or below the age line count as delays
map.，右侧较难项目未通过不计延迟。判定口径：年龄线及以下 ≥2 项延迟为异常、1 项: , and harder items to the right do not count as delays. Decision rule: 2 or more delays on or below the age line = abnormal, 1 = suspicious, 0 = normal; if items on or below the age line are still unmarked, the page shows incomplete data instead of a normal result.
map.儿保体检前，家长按年龄线逐项自评并记录未通过项。: Before a well-child visit, parents self-check items along the age line and note those not passed.
map.语言、运动等里程碑的粗筛记录，便于就诊时向医生描述。: Keep a rough record of language and motor milestones to describe to the doctor.
map.转诊前整理「哪些项目未通过」，供专业人员参考。: Before referral, list which items were not passed for the professional to review.
map.：年龄线及以下的「说 10-20 词」「说 2 字短语」均标记未通过 ⇒ 语言能: : marking both "says 10-20 words" and "says two-word phrases" on or below the age line as failed gives 2 language delays, so the language domain is abnormal and the overall result is abnormal; the page suggests a developmental referral. It does not require a normal re-check first.
map.年龄线及以下全部通过: All items on or below the age line passed
map.：各能区延迟项为 0、且无未测项 ⇒ 总体判为正常。判定看延迟项数量，不看通过率: : zero delayed items in every domain with no untested items gives a normal overall result. The decision uses the number of delays, not a pass-rate percentage.
map.只测了一半项目: Only half of the items tested
map.：年龄线及以下仍有项目未标记 ⇒ 总体显示「资料不完整」，提示补测后再判读。: : items on or below the age line are still unmarked, so the page shows incomplete data and asks you to finish before interpreting.

Preterm infants may be assessed by corrected age up to 2 years; if several delays appear or concerns persist, seek a standardized assessment in primary care or developmental-behavioral pediatrics.
map.为什么结果显示「资料不完整」？: Why does the result say incomplete data?
map.年龄线及以下仍有项目未标记通过/未通过时，本页不给出「正常」结论，而是提示资料不: When items on or below the age line are still unmarked, the page does not conclude normal; it shows incomplete data. Finish the unmarked items, then interpret.
map.通过率很高为什么不算正常？: Why is a high pass rate not considered normal?
map.本页按「年龄线及以下的延迟项数量」判定，而不是按通过率百分比：0 项延迟为正常、: The page decides by the number of delays on or below the age line, not by a pass-rate percentage: 0 delays = normal, 1 = suspicious, 2 or more = abnormal. Failed harder items to the right of the age line do not count as delays.
